heightEncoding.note: Step is fitted to this interior's own vertical range, so the six-bit field spans it without clamping. The Godot loader still takes elevation from the rendered Walk_ surfaces; this grid is authoritative only for walkability.

cutaway.reason: interior lids; the isometric rig frames the floor, not the roof

notes: Every standable surface is a Walk_<material> node: the client turns navigation.surfaceNodePrefixes into the layer its downward grounding ray tests, so a floor emitted as ordinary geometry is scenery you fall through.

sections.name: The Glacier Temple
notes: The glacier is taking the monastery. The colonnade's east wall is cracked and bulging with ice through the joints; the last built arch is half-swallowed; and the columns in the altar chamber are an older colonnade the ice has carried off its foundations, still in rows and all leaning the same way.

sections.name: The Whitehorn Mine
notes: The crevasse span is kit.rope_bridge, the same piece the exterior uses on the gorge: the miners who bridged one bridged the other.

sections.name: The Whitehorn Ice Cave
notes: Nobody built this. The only worked things in it are the hung lamps and the plank walk over the pool.

sections.name: The Frost Barrow
notes: Older than the monastery and not of it. The monks walled the end chamber rather than empty it, and left a shrine at the wall.

sections.name: The Snowline Cell
notes: Built from the shared small-room kit: a cut sanctuary in the stone manner.

sections.name: The Cascade Cave
notes: Built from the shared small-room kit: mouth, throat and chamber, dressed for the region above it.

sections.name: The Ration Sister's Store
notes: Built from the shared small-room kit: a hall with a hearth and a back room for its trade (chandlery).

provenance.geometry: authored with the shared Nymara toolkit and this region's own kit.py; no scattered placement

notes: Four insides on one map with unwalkable void between them, in the Eternal Lands manner: one GLB, one collision grid and one server map key, entered at a different arrival depending on which surface door was used.

The void is not drawn. The collision grid is built only where a Walk_ surface exists, so the gutters are blocked already, and nothing is rendered in them - walking off a section's edge finds no floor and no geometry.
Section offsets keep at least 20 m of nothing between any two, checked at build time.
